Container.Name: MuxFlow
Container.Overview:
MuxFlow is a modern, responsive MKV batch muxing web suite powered by MKVToolNix (mkvmerge & mkvpropedit). Designed for seamless desktop and mobile browser use. Features smart track filtering, subtitle/audio flag controls, font & attachment injection, preset management, same-directory safety protection, and an automated job queue.
[b]Features:[/b] - Modern Web GUI with Dark & Light themes - Fast batch queue with real-time progress - Smart audio & subtitle track filtering and bulk language editing - Font attachment folder scanning and injection - Native MKVToolNix performance - Safe output suffixing to protect original files
